title: Traitor
html:
Traitor is a special status, that is obtained by a player, bot or nation when they break their alliance, or when they (potentially accidentally) blow up part of an ally’s territory with a nuke.

Details

The traitor gives a global 50% reduction to your defense when defending against an attack. This means that the attacker loses 50% less troops during an attack. You will also lose 20% attack speed. The traitor debuff lasts for 30 seconds. If you are allied to a traitor you can break your alliance with them without becoming a traitor yourself.

This reduction does not only apply to attacks coming from the country you betrayed, but to every other player/bot/nation on the map.

See Combat for more details about the combat formulas for troop loss.
